products.title: Stud Stop
products.excerpt: Before you order, check “Inventory Update” on HOMEPAGE. This simple threaded stop slides over the threads when it is tilted, but then engages the threaded stud when it is squared to the tool. Real convenient for quickly setting up a stop for the tool to press against. Purchase this to reduce excessive “nut twiddling”. NOTE Already contained in the following kits: HSBP-1 Acetal HSBP-2 Aluminum ALT Drift ALTD-2 The Hub & Suspension Bearing Press EXPANSION (HSBP-1X) and the Basic Bearing Press kits DO NOT come with the Stud Stop.
